name: 3 Finger Gestures
author: Joey Morrison
description: Three-finger touchpad gestures for Omarchy: swipe sideways to change workspace, swipe down to minimize a window into a bottom tray, swipe up to bring it back. Settings live in the bar.

barWidget.description: Tune the workspace swipe and the minimize tray without leaving the bar.

schema.label: Minimize gestures
schema.description: Three fingers down minimizes into the tray, three fingers up brings it back. Off leaves only the workspace swipe.

schema.label: Swipe distance
schema.description: Higher: the screen follows your fingers more slowly.

schema.label: Swipe commit ratio
schema.description: How much of a swipe commits to the next workspace. Lower: less.

schema.label: Flick speed
schema.description: A flick faster than this commits regardless of distance.

schema.label: Glide speed
schema.description: Speed of the glide after you let go. Lower: slower. 0: leave Omarchy's animations alone.

schema.label: Instant SUPER+1..0
schema.description: Keyboard workspace switches skip the glide.

schema.label: Persistent workspaces
schema.description: Keep workspaces 1..N alive so a swipe visits each one in order and never creates new ones past N. 0 disables.

schema.label: Tray keyboard key
schema.description: Hands the keyboard to the tray: Left/Right pick a tile, Enter restores, Escape lets go.

schema.label: Tray capacity
schema.description: How many windows the tray holds (1 to 12).

schema.label: Thumbnails
schema.description: Show a picture of each minimized window in its tile.

schema.label: Reserve space
schema.description: Tiled windows shrink to make room for the tray instead of it floating over the bottom edge.
